Method of Attack: Encrypts victim's files using AES-256 encryption and appends .crptrgr extension
Retrieves MD5 hash of original files and stores with filename in %AppData%\files.txt
Creates ransom note !Where_are_my_files!.html with instructions to contact developer via uTox
Requires victim to send keys.dat file (encrypted AES key) to developer for decryption
Creates .VBS file in Windows Startup folder to run ransomware on each login
